mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reports (target_type, target_id, reporter_id, reason, content, status) VALUES (#{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{reporterId}, #{reason}, #{content}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT id AS reportId, target_type AS targetType, target_id AS targetId, reporter_id AS reporterId, reason, content, status, created_at AS createdAt FROM reports WHERE id = #{reportId}
